primary_imaging.smoothing: Periodic Gaussian, physical standard deviation one kernel length
primary_imaging.reason: Common observation cadence across original and dense-profile experiments prevents a profile-cadence change from becoming an apparent change in birth rate.

sensitivities.basal_reference: Exact retained basal processed with the same optics

complete_amount: Piecewise-linear integral above instantaneous native minimum over complete native-peak watershed basins; imaging contour never truncates the amount. Resolve subcell saddle continuously. Ambiguous active saddles flag unavailable amounts. A former dominant below the imaging contour retains its resolved native-peak basins by unique spatial association. Missing, merged or unresolved former amounts are never assigned zero.
dominance: Newborn versus previous dominant D=(E_new-E_old)/(E_new+E_old)>0.5 for at least two consecutive observed frames; both complete amounts must be available.
identity: Maximum material-cell contour overlap, explicit observed splits and mergers. Initial tracks are left-censored; merger/low-contrast/window-end identities are right-censored. Lifetimes refer to observed contour components, not known physical birth/death times.
physical_arc: Use each native frame actual circumference, including Spring; births divided by integrated perimeter-time exposure. The original Spring forcing remains material-attached and is distinct from the fixed-physical optical filter.
tests: 16 analytic and end-to-end adapter tests passed before freezing.

strict_takeover_qc_revision.primary: Require newborn dominant among qualified observed regions AND pairD>0.5 in each of two frames. Independent pairwise streak retained; early pairwise event does not preempt later global event. Unresolved ordering remains unscorable. This corrects the operational interpretation after QC, not selection of an outcome-promoting statistic.
